health-topic.title: Iron Deficiency Anemia
health-topic.full-summary: Iron deficiency anemia happens when your body does not have enough iron to make hemoglobin. Common symptoms are tiredness, pale skin and shortness of breath. Treatment is iron tablets for 3 to 6 months and a diet with iron-rich foods. See a doctor before taking iron supplements.

health-topic.title: Anemia por deficiencia de hierro
health-topic.full-summary: La anemia por deficiencia de hierro ocurre cuando el cuerpo no tiene suficiente hierro para producir hemoglobina. Los síntomas comunes son cansancio, piel pálida y falta de aire. El tratamiento consiste en tabletas de hierro durante 3 a 6 meses y una dieta rica en hierro. Consulte a un médico antes de tomar suplementos de hierro.

health-topic.title: Migraine
health-topic.full-summary: A migraine is a headache that can cause severe throbbing pain, often on one side of the head. Attacks last 4 to 72 hours. Triggers include stress, certain foods and lack of sleep. A doctor can prescribe medicines to prevent or treat attacks.

health-topic.title: Migraña
health-topic.full-summary: La migraña es un dolor de cabeza que puede causar un dolor pulsátil intenso, a menudo en un lado de la cabeza. Los ataques duran de 4 a 72 horas. Los desencadenantes incluyen el estrés, ciertos alimentos y la falta de sueño. Un médico puede recetar medicinas para prevenir o tratar los ataques.

health-topic.title: Sunburn
health-topic.full-summary: Sunburn is red, painful skin that feels hot to the touch after too much sun. It usually appears within a few hours and fades in 2 to 7 days. Cool baths and moisturizer help; avoid the sun until it heals.

health-topic.title: Hiccups
health-topic.full-summary: Hiccups are spasms of the diaphragm. They usually stop on their own within a few minutes. Hiccups that last more than 48 hours need a doctor's attention.

health-topic.title: COVID-19
health-topic.full-summary: COVID-19 is an illness caused by a coronavirus. Symptoms appear 2 to 14 days after exposure and include fever, cough and tiredness. Most people recover at home; call a doctor if breathing becomes difficult.

health-topic.title: COVID-19
health-topic.full-summary: El COVID-19 es una enfermedad causada por un coronavirus. Los síntomas aparecen de 2 a 14 días después de la exposición e incluyen fiebre, tos y cansancio. La mayoría de las personas se recupera en casa; llame a un médico si le cuesta respirar.
